cues: Meiosis then hands one chromatid to each of four gametes: two parental types, A B and a b, and two recombinants, A small b and small a B.
The chiasma itself is the visible mark of a crossover that has already happened: Janssens' chiasmatype theory.
The chiasmata then slide to the ends in diplotene and diakinesis: terminalisation.
